title: styles
description: Illustration style catalog (styles.json). Each style carries the prompt-assembly strings that turn a subject prompt into an imagegen request; style rides in the prompt, not in the model (DESIGN §9, §10).

styles.description: All available styles. The admin picker sorts consistency_friendly first.

id.description: Stable style id referenced by meta.style_id.

name.description: Human-readable style name for the picker.

imagegen_style.description: The imagegen-service style preset name to forward on /generate to apply that style's LoRA (e.g. 'oil painting'), or null for prompt-only styles that carry no LoRA (DESIGN §10, ADR-0013).

consistency_friendly.description: Whether character identity stays consistent across plates in this style. Unfriendly styles get a drift warning in the picker (DESIGN §9).

prefix.description: String prepended to the subject prompt for plates (leading style cues).

suffix.description: String appended to the subject prompt for plates (trailing style cues).

negative.description: Base negative prompt for this style; joined with derived.avoid at render (DESIGN §10).

portrait_prefix.description: String prepended to portrait subject prompts (bust-composition style cues).

params.description: Optional imagegen parameter overrides for this style. Null values mean 'use the imagegen default'; v1 leaves both null (DESIGN §9).

steps.description: Override for the number of diffusion steps, or null for the imagegen default.

cfg.description: Override for the CFG guidance scale, or null for the imagegen default.
